messages:
alex_k: Heads-up — Aurora Health POC hit a hard blocker during load test, seeing burst 429s and a couple 503s. Need a quick war-room.

maria_t: Ugh. Which endpoint? generation or embeddings?

alex_k: generation API, multi-request burst from their orchestrator. 4k reqs/min in bursts, most small payloads. Logs show token latency spikes then 429.

samir_r: Can you paste the logs? Also what model and routing policy are they on?

alex_k: model: redwood/gpt-medium-v1 (hosted). routing: default -> hosted tier. Here's a sample from our request logs: 
```
2026-03-18T14:02:12Z request_id=abc123 client=aurora-poc latency_ms=1450 status=200 tokens_out=64
2026-03-18T14:02:12Z request_id=abc124 client=aurora-poc latency_ms=3120 status=429 reason=rate_limit
2026-03-18T14:02:13Z request_id=abc125 client=aurora-poc latency_ms=4800 status=503 reason=backend_unavailable
```

devon_ops: Looks like concurrent limit + queueing. Their orchestrator fires parallel requests without retry backoff. Are they using batching?

olivia_sales: Customer asked about pricing impacts if we add burst capacity. Also they're worried about security questionnaire items if we ask them to change orchestrator behavior.

maria_t: Priorities: 1) get POC stable, 2) minimize extra cost, 3) write guidance for their infra & update security notes.

samir_r: Immediate mitigation: enable short-term autoscale burst on their tenant (Dedicated burst) or flip routing policy to 'fallback-to-smaller-batch' — but hosted burst may take 5-10m. Want me to enable a temporary burst?

alex_k: Yes please. If we can flip to fallback routing to a lower-latency model variant first, that might reduce 429s quickly. If autoscale is faster, do that too.

devon_ops: I can provision a temporary +30% burst for the tenant for 2 hours. Will need billing sign-off after. Doing it now.

oncall-bot: [alert] tenant=aurora-poc autoscale_request by=devon_ops status=initiated at=2026-03-18T14:08:05Z

olivia_sales: I'll ping their procurement and explain temporary burst is a trial and we can include cost estimate. Can you both get me numbers?

maria_t: Samir, also add recommended client-side changes (simple jittered exponential backoff + concurrency limit). They mustn't rely on instantaneous retries.

samir_r: Agreed. Proposed snippet for their orchestrator: 
```
max_concurrency = 20
for attempt in range(0,3):
  resp = call_redwood_api()
  if resp.status == 200: break
  sleep( (2 ** attempt) * 0.1 + jitter() )
```

alex_k: Also note prefix caching — many of their requests share prompts with small differences. We should recommend enabling prefix caching on their route to cut token cost and latency. Ops: can we enable prefix/KV caching for their model route?

devon_ops: Yes, toggling prefix_cache=true on their route now. That should help repeated prompts.

oncall-bot: [deployment] route_update tenant=aurora-poc prefix_cache=true by=devon_ops at=2026-03-18T14:11:00Z

samir_r: Quick check: 429 reason code variants? token_bucket or concurrent_request_limit?

alex_k: Mix. Mostly concurrent_request_limit in logs, a few token_bucket.

samir_r: I added a small rate-limit advisory to their onboarding doc and a sample concurrency header usage. Also propose they use client-side rate limit window smoothing.

maria_t: Olivia — for pricing: burst autoscale for 2 hours at +30% estimated delta ~$1.2k based on their avg tokens; if we extend, we should propose monthly reserved burst package.

olivia_sales: I'll draft a short note and a 1-week trial offer with a one-time credit to cover initial burst. Send me exact numbers and a line for legal re: security.

samir_r: For security questionnaire: toggling prefix_cache doesn't change data residency but note that KV cache uses in-memory encrypted cache. I'll prepare a 1-paragraph blurb for them and the security team.

alex_k: After changes, we're still seeing a small number of 503s — looks like backend pod OOMs on longer sequences. Can we enforce max_input_tokens=256 on their route temporarily?

devon_ops: I can set request_size_limit=256 for the route. Doing that now.

noncall-bot: [route_update] tenant=aurora-poc request_size_limit=256 by=devon_ops at=2026-03-18T14:22:31Z

alex_k: After the fixes: fewer 429s, tail latency improved. Will run 30m soak and report.

maria_t: Good. Action items: devon to confirm burst toggle and limits (done), samir to send sample backoff snippet + security blurb (in progress), olivia to send pricing trial note (pending).

olivia_sales: I'll message procurement and schedule a 30-min sync with their infra in 90 minutes.

alex_k: Thanks team — keep this thread updated. If soak fails, we escalate to eng-runtime oncall.

samir_r: Uploading security blurb to the shared drive and will paste in thread after review.

alex_k: new metrics after 10m: 429s down to ~0.5% of requests, 503s -> none in last 6m. Seems stable.

olivia_sales: Great — I'll close the war-room after the 30m soak and record notes for the deal. :thumbsup:
